messages.subject: Sustainability & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Moon Executive Search Team,

Your retained executive-search work across renewable energy, environmental and sustainability leadership aligns with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where sustainability strategy, responsible development and institutional relationships are central to performance. I am internationally mobile and open to senior global appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
